context: Attribute names with labels, levels, variable role (driver_demographics / driver_behavior / vehicle_attribute / safety_feature / environment / accident_outcome / cost_outcome), domain category, and brief description — functional context without explicit causal direction.

variables.name: GoodStudent
variables.label: Good student status
variables.description: Whether the driver qualifies as a good student (typically via GPA thresholds); associated with insurance discounts and used as a demographic risk proxy.

variables.name: Age
variables.label: Driver age group
variables.description: Driver's age bracket; a primary demographic risk factor affecting both driving skill development and eligibility for senior training programs.

variables.name: SocioEcon
variables.label: Socio-economic status
variables.description: Household socio-economic tier; influences vehicle choice, neighbourhood of residence, and access to safety features.

variables.name: RiskAversion
variables.label: Risk aversion tendency
variables.description: Driver's dispositional attitude toward risk-taking; directly shapes driving behaviour and quality, and indirectly influences accident probability.

variables.name: VehicleYear
variables.label: Vehicle model year
variables.description: Whether the vehicle is the current model year or older; newer vehicles more likely to have modern safety features including ABS and airbags.

variables.name: ThisCarDam
variables.label: Damage to insured car
variables.description: Physical damage severity sustained by the insured vehicle; determined by accident severity and the vehicle's structural ruggedness.

variables.name: RuggedAuto
variables.label: Vehicle structural ruggedness
variables.description: Structural crashworthiness of the vehicle; influenced by make/model class and moderates how accident severity translates into vehicle damage.

variables.name: Accident
variables.label: Accident severity
variables.description: Overall severity of the accident event; the central outcome node driven by driving quality, mileage, and whether another car is involved.

variables.name: MakeModel
variables.label: Car make/model class
variables.description: Broad vehicle category; determines car value, ruggedness, likelihood of antilock brakes, and availability of airbags.

variables.name: DrivQuality
variables.label: Driving quality
variables.description: Synthesized measure of how well a driver operates the vehicle; jointly determined by driving skill and risk aversion attitude.

variables.name: Mileage
variables.label: Annual mileage bucket
variables.description: Annual miles driven; higher mileage increases exposure to accident risk regardless of driver skill.

variables.name: Antilock
variables.label: Antilock braking system (ABS)
variables.description: Presence of ABS; reduces braking distance and improves vehicle control in emergency stops, lowering accident probability.

variables.name: DrivingSkill
variables.label: Driver skill level
variables.description: Technical driving competency; shaped by age and driving history, and is a direct input to driving quality.

variables.name: SeniorTrain
variables.label: Senior driver training
variables.description: Whether the driver has completed a senior driver training program; applicable mainly to Senior age group and improves driving skill.

variables.name: ThisCarCost
variables.label: Insured car claim cost
variables.description: Financial cost bucket for repairing or replacing the insured car; driven by damage severity and car value.

variables.name: Theft
variables.label: Vehicle theft
variables.description: Whether the insured vehicle is stolen; probability depends on car value, home neighbourhood security, and presence of anti-theft systems.

variables.name: CarValue
variables.label: Insured car value
variables.description: Market value bucket of the insured car; determined by make/model and vehicle year, and directly affects theft probability and repair costs.

variables.name: HomeBase
variables.label: Home neighbourhood type
variables.description: Type of neighbourhood where the vehicle is primarily kept; influences theft risk and contextual accident exposure.

variables.name: AntiTheft
variables.label: Anti-theft system
variables.description: Presence of an anti-theft device; directly reduces the probability of vehicle theft.

variables.name: PropCost
variables.label: Proportional cost comparison
variables.description: Relative cost bucket comparing insured car costs to other-car costs; a derived aggregation node used for overall claim sizing.

variables.name: OtherCarCost
variables.label: Other car claim cost
variables.description: Financial cost bucket for the other vehicle involved in the accident; depends on accident severity and whether another car was involved.

variables.name: OtherCar
variables.label: Other vehicle involved
variables.description: Whether a second vehicle is involved in the incident; affects both accident probability amplification and third-party cost liability.

variables.name: MedCost
variables.label: Medical treatment cost
variables.description: Medical cost bucket for injuries sustained; driven by accident severity and occupant cushioning/protection quality.

variables.name: Cushioning
variables.label: Occupant cushioning quality
variables.description: Overall passenger protection quality inside the vehicle; determined by the presence of airbags and the vehicle's ruggedness.

variables.name: Airbag
variables.label: Airbag present
variables.description: Whether the vehicle is equipped with airbags; a primary determinant of occupant cushioning quality in a crash.

variables.name: ILiCost
variables.label: Injury / liability cost
variables.description: Injury and liability cost bucket; aggregates medical costs and legal liability into a total injury-related cost outcome.

variables.name: DrivHist
variables.label: Prior driving incidents
variables.description: Bucketed count of prior at-fault accidents or moving violations; directly informs driving skill assessment and actuarial risk rating.
